notServer.title: This is not the server PC
notServer.body: The emergency tool works only on the PC where ARTEPOOL's database and server are installed. Open it from the Start menu of the server PC.

menu.title: ARTEPOOL – Emergency tool
menu.subtitle: For when the owner cannot sign in, or something does not work. Every action is written to the audit log.

password.title: Owner's password
password.body: The owner forgot the password and "Forgot your password?" cannot be used. A temporary password is shown once.

twoStep.title: Owner's phone code (2-step)
twoStep.body: Both the phone and the recovery codes are lost. The owner sets up the phone again at the next sign-in.

code.title: Enrollment code for a PC
code.body: A one-time code, valid for 10 minutes, to connect a PC to this server.

check.title: Check the system
check.body: The database, the server, the backups, the protected secrets.

logs.title: The logs folder
logs.body: C:\ProgramData\ARTEPOOL\logs — send it to support when asked.
logs.failed: The folder could not be opened.

reason.label: Why is this needed?
reason.hint: Required, at least 3 characters. Kept in the audit log.

password.title: Reset the owner's password
password.subtitle: If the owner still has the phone and a recovery code, use "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in screen instead.
password.phoneLost: The phone with the 2-step code is lost too (the phone code is cleared as well)
password.warning: All the owner's sessions end and no PC stays trusted.
password.doneFor: For {username}. Write it down now: it is shown only this once.
password.next: Sign in with it on any PC; the app asks for a new password at once.
password.nextTwoStepCleared: After the password, the app asks to set up the phone again.
password.nextTwoStepKept: The 6-digit code from the phone is still needed.

twoStep.title: Clear the owner's phone code
twoStep.subtitle: Use this only if the phone and the recovery codes are both lost.
twoStep.warning: All the owner's sessions end. At the next sign-in the owner sets up a new phone.
twoStep.doneFor: For {username}. At the next sign-in, the app asks to set up the phone again.

code.title: Enrollment code for a PC
code.subtitle: Type it on the new PC together with this server's address. Any earlier unused code stops working.
code.label: Enrollment code

check.title: Check the system
check.notAllGood: Something does not work. Restart the PC; if it stays red, open the logs folder and send it to support.

errors.not_server_pc: This is not the server PC.
errors.launch_failed: The emergency program could not run. Close this window, open the tool again from the Start menu and accept the administrator prompt.
errors.bad_input: Something is missing in the form.
errors.reason_required: Write why this is needed (at least 3 characters).
errors.no_owner: There is no owner yet. Finish the first-run setup first.
errors.database_unreachable: The database does not answer. Restart the PC and try again; if it still fails, send the logs folder to support.
errors.failed: It did not work. Nothing was changed.
